statusLine.command: jq -r 'def d(f): ((f // 0) / 60000 | floor) as $m | if $m >= 60 then "\($m / 60 | floor)h\($m % 60)m" else "\($m)m" end; def sz: if . >= 1e6 then "\(. / 1e6)M" else "\(. / 1e3 | floor)k" end; (.cost.total_cost_usd // 0 | . * 100 | round) as $c | ((.prompt_cache.expires_at // 0) - now) as $s | (if .prompt_cache.warm and $s > 0 then "with \($s / 60 | floor)m warm" else "but cold" end) as $k | "\(.model.display_name) \(.effort.level // "-") · Cost $\($c / 100 | floor).\("0\($c % 100)"[-2:]) · Context \(.context_window.used_percentage // 0 | round)% of \(.context_window.context_window_size // 0 | sz)\nCache hit \((.prompt_cache.hit_ratio // 0) * 100 | round)% \($k) · API \(d(.cost.total_api_duration_ms)) of \(d(.cost.total_duration_ms)) session"'
